scientific_integrity: A complete combinatorial and likelihood-ratio proof is given; independent exact rational and integer finite replay checks are included. No external or independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-sample theorem for inversion-weighted Mallows permutations; not a statement on joint fixed-point events or other permutation distances. The Gaussian-binomial and q-Vandermonde identities used are classical; potential older one-point-marginal priority remains.
title: Sharp center-to-edge reversal of fixed-point marginals in finite Mallows permutations
